studies.label: MOUNTAIN — zuranolone in MDD
studies.intervention: Zuranolone (registry: SAGE-217), 20 or 30 mg daily for 14 days
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 581 actual; the paper reports 581 randomized. The captured registry names Biogen as lead sponsor; publication affiliations include Sage. These source-specific labels do not establish ownership or development rights.

studies.label: Aticaprant adjunctive MDD trial
studies.indication: MDD with inadequate response to SSRI/SNRI
studies.intervention: Aticaprant (registry: JNJ-67953964) 10 mg daily added to ongoing antidepressant
studies.comparator: Matched placebo added to ongoing antidepressant, after placebo lead-in
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 181 actual. The paper's abstract says 184 enrolled, while its Study results section says 181 entered lead-in and 169 were randomized/treated; 166 formed the full efficacy set and 121 the enriched primary set. The publication discrepancy remains unresolved. The original paper confirms the NCT identifier in its Study design section; no reference is listed in this registry snapshot.

studies.label: PYXIS — adjunctive brexpiprazole
studies.intervention: Brexpiprazole (registry: OPC-34712) 2 mg plus antidepressant therapy
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 826 actual, including the lead-in population. The paper reports efficacy groups of 175 and 178 under final-protocol criteria. Registry endpoints occur at week 14 after the week-8 lead-in baseline; the paper describes six randomized treatment weeks. Repeated Placebo + ADT intervention rows refer to distinct study phases.

studies.label: Vortioxetine cognitive-function trial
studies.intervention: Vortioxetine 10 or 20 mg daily for eight weeks
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 598 actual; the publication abstract reports 602 randomized. The reason for this difference is unverified. Registry completion date is absent; primary completion is 2013-05 actual. Start is 2011-12 with type unreported. Repeated vortioxetine intervention rows belong to separate dose arms.

studies.label: Brexanolone severe postpartum-depression trial
studies.intervention: Brexanolone (registry: SAGE-547), 60-hour infusion targeting 60 or 90 micrograms/kg/hour
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 138 actual. The publication also reports a second trial, NCT02942017, which is not included here. The captured registry names Supernus Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; the older publication names Sage in funding and affiliations. These source-specific labels do not establish corporate ownership.

studies.label: Lumateperone bipolar-depression trial
studies.indication: Major depressive episode in bipolar I or II disorder
studies.intervention: Lumateperone 42 mg daily for six weeks
studies.caution: The registry reports 381 ACTUAL enrollment. Bipolar I/II populations are not interchangeable with the existing unipolar MDD programme mappings.

studies.label: EMERGENT-2 — xanomeline/trospium
studies.caution: Registry enrollment and publication randomization are both 252. Paper enrollment dates and registry completion dates refer to different events. The displayed sponsor is the captured registry's exact label; it does not establish independent corporate identity.

studies.label: SEP-363856 schizophrenia trial
studies.intervention: SEP-363856, 50 or 75 mg daily for four weeks
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 245 actual; publication groups contain 120 and 125 participants. The paper names Sunovion as funder whereas the captured registry names Otsuka Pharmaceutical Development & Commercialization, Inc. This Phase 2 example does not establish outcomes of later trials.

studies.label: PACT — prazosin in military veterans
studies.indication: PTSD with nightmares and sleep disturbance
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 304 actual and the paper reports 304 randomized. The retained registry flag healthyVolunteers=true conflicts with patient-specific PTSD inclusion criteria and the publication population. It is a source discrepancy, not evidence that the enrolled cohort consisted of healthy volunteers.

studies.label: Suvorexant insomnia/Alzheimer's trial
studies.indication: Insomnia in probable Alzheimer's disease dementia
studies.intervention: Suvorexant 10 mg nightly, potentially increased to 20 mg
studies.caution: Registry enrollment is 285 actual and the paper reports 285 randomized. All three registry primary outcomes are retained: total sleep time, adverse events, and discontinuation due to adverse events. The publication abstract emphasizes the sleep efficacy endpoint. This is not a trial of disease modification in Alzheimer's disease.
